method: Unchanged A108 sufficient-certificate and exact atlas/direct-regression method used in P2-P4. No predictor, KKT condition, support, tolerance, or boundary rule changes.

adjudication.pass: Every selected record receives the sufficient certificate, matches its already-frozen parent prediction and exact atlas classification, has the predeclared boundary behavior, and has zero exact direct-regression mismatches/failures.
adjudication.refute: Any exact non-target nonpositivity, parent-prediction mismatch, atlas mismatch, boundary mismatch, or exact direct-regression failure.
adjudication.inconclusive: Certification/execution failure without a mathematical counterexample.

no_posthoc_changes: No deletion, replacement, rank changes, shard resizing based on outcomes, predictor edits, condition substitution, tolerance changes, or rescue classifier.
